fact: A World Bank mission aide-memoire of April-May 2026 states that data collection and entry for Kenya's Annual Vital Statistics Report were completed in April 2026 (the third and final report under the Program) and that the Annual Agricultural Reports for 2025 and 2026 are complete, under the programme's improved availability of administrative data indicator.
title: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results, Kenya Component: Implementation Support Mission April 27 - May 7, 2026, Aide-Memoire
